qualityChecks.title: Material check
qualityChecks.body: Film is checked before production, so every balloon starts from good-quality plastic film.

qualityChecks.title: Print & colour check
qualityChecks.body: Printed artwork is checked for colour, sharpness and alignment, so the balloon matches the design you chose.

qualityChecks.title: Seal check
qualityChecks.body: Edges are checked after heat sealing for gaps or weak spots that could let air escape.

qualityChecks.title: Inflation test
qualityChecks.body: Sample balloons from each batch are inflated to check the shape and that they hold air.

qualityChecks.title: Counted & packed clean
qualityChecks.body: Balloons are counted, folded flat and packed clean, so your order arrives ready to sell or use.

faqs.question: What are foil balloons made from?
faqs.answer: Common constructions use thin plastic film, such as nylon or PET-based laminates, with layers selected for the design and finish. Confirm the exact material and intended use with Toyon for the products you are considering.

faqs.question: What is the minimum order quantity?
faqs.answer: Ask Toyon to confirm the minimum order quantity for your selected designs. Include the products and quantities you have in mind in your enquiry; no fixed MOQ is published here.

faqs.question: Where is Toyon located?
faqs.answer: Toyon Industry Private Limited is based at A/06, Gaytri Ind. Estate, Nr. Central Workshop Odhav, Odhav Industrial Estate, Ahmedabad, Gujarat, 382415, India.

faqs.question: What should I include in a manufacturing enquiry?
faqs.answer: Share your selected designs, required quantities, intended use and any material, printing, packaging or inspection requirements. The company can then discuss the requirements relevant to your enquiry.
